headline: BOH Q2 Earnings Beat on Strong NII, Stock Dips on Lower Fee Income
summary: Bank of Hawaii's Q2 results benefit from higher NII, margin expansion and loan growth. However, shares plunge 4.7% as fee income and deposit balances decline.
